question: Estimate the cumulative reach of a 7-day digital campaign on Hotstar/JioCinema for a movie launch.
idealClarificationQuestions: Streaming platform pre-roll + mid-roll + masthead + display ads for movie promo? Yes.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Frame the approach
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Budget / CPM = impressions; multiplied across formats.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Movie marketing budget on JioHotstar/JioCinema for major release: ~₹2-3 crore on this platform alone.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Total impressions: ₹2.5 cr / ₹120 × 1,000 = 2.1 crore impressions over 7 days.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Unique reach: ~1.2-1.5 crore unique JioCinema/Hotstar users.

benchmarkAssumptions.parameter: Movie marketing budget on JioHotstar/JioCinema for major release

calculationFlow: Movie marketing budget on JioHotstar/JioCinema for major release: ~₹2-3 crore on this platform alone.
JioCinema/Hotstar CPM for movie ads: ~₹100-150 (premium content).
Total impressions: ₹2.5 cr / ₹120 × 1,000 = 2.1 crore impressions over 7 days.
Plus masthead takeover (1-2 days): adds 1-1.5 crore impressions.
Plus organic platform exposure (banners, recommendations): 1 crore additional.
Unique reach: ~1.2-1.5 crore unique JioCinema/Hotstar users.

finalAnswerRange.ideal: Unique reach: ~1.2-1.5 crore unique JioCinema/Hotstar users.
